texto: The PDF came through the second I finished checking out. I printed it because I find it much easier to read on paper, and I flagged a bunch of pages. It's explained in a simple way, without all the heavy medical jargon.

I figured it'd be just another guide full of general tips, but it's packed with information and it's well organized. Some topics I already knew, others made me pay more attention to my habits. I keep it printed next to my desk to check.

I haven't finished the whole thing yet, but so far I really like it. I had it spiral-bound since it's a lot of pages, so I can read it at my own pace. What I value most is that it doesn't promise miracles.
I bought it mainly for the circulation and memory topics. There are really simple recommendations you sometimes overlook. I printed it and already tabbed the parts I want to reread.

My daughter helped me buy it and then we printed it together. It's very clear and easy to understand even for those of us who know nothing about medicine. I jotted a few things down to ask at my next appointment.

I was surprised by how many topics it covers. Not everything was new to me, but it helped me have the information gathered in one place and better organized. Delivery was instant and I printed it with no trouble.

I bought the guide out of curiosity and ended up reading a lot more than I expected. I especially liked that the explanations are short and to the point. I have it spiral-bound and read a few pages a day.

At my age I prefer reading on paper, so my granddaughter printed the file for me. The print is easy to see and the topics are clearly separated. I found it a useful guide to learn and take care of myself more mindfully.

It arrived in my inbox right away and I was able to print it at home. I liked that it covers a range of topics and not just one disease or one remedy. It's handy to reference, though of course it doesn't replace a doctor's opinion.

I bought it for my mom, but I ended up reading it too. It has useful information for older folks and also for those of us past 40 who want to start taking care of ourselves earlier. The printout came out really nice and complete.
